title: Sr. Data Science Analyst
description:
Overview

Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians! At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses — by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market. Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike. We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact — who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible. If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Data Scientist on the Product team, you will be responsible for:

  • Develop and implement advanced machine learning models to quantify the risk level of transactions and credit operations, and optimize user onboarding and reduce losses.
  • Design and conduct complex data analyses on large volumes of transactional, user behavior, and demographic data to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for model enhancement.
  • Optimize and maintain existing credit models, ensuring their stability, accuracy, and business impact through continuous monitoring and refinement.
  • Lead the design and execution of A/B tests and other experiments related to credit decision strategies, translating results into actionable business recommendations.
  • Build and optimize robust and scalable data pipelines for model training, inference, and performance monitoring.
  • Contribute to the adoption of best practices in data science, including model documentation, version control (Git), and code quality.

Requirements

  • Experience in data science, with a proven track record of independently developing and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.
  • Programming and Tools: Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Spark. Experience with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn. Familiarity with platforms like Databricks, AWS, and Azure. Experience with Git for version control and collaboration.
  • Analytical Modeling & Machine Learning: Strong experience in building and implementing machine learning models. Solid knowledge of classification, regression, and clustering algorithms, as well as feature engineering and model selection techniques. Experience with model explanation techniques.
  • Data Analysis: Ability to handle large datasets and write efficient, optimized SQL queries. Strong experience with exploratory data analysis and evaluating model features.
  • Statistical Knowledge: Strong understanding of A/B testing and statistics, including experimental design and statistical significance. Proficient knowledge of predictive modeling metrics like AUC, KS, precision, and recall.
  • Other Skills: Knowledge of data modeling principles and experience building robust and scalable data models. An analytical mindset with a strong focus on problem-solving. Strong mathematical skills with the ability to optimize complex problems.
  • Innovative Thinking: Applying theoretical knowledge of statistics, economics, and behavioral finance to optimize proposed solutions.
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable business insights and communicate them clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaboration: Willingness to work in a collaborative and dynamic environment, actively contributing to team knowledge sharing.

Bonus Points

  • Proficiency with PySpark for distributed data processing in large-scale environments.
  • Experience with MLOps and deploying machine learning models into production.
  • Familiarity with model monitoring in production environments.
  • Exposure to Open Finance, credit bureau data, or behavioral features.
  • Previous experience in fintechs or financial services companies.

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.
  • Spanish or Portuguese classes.

Diversity & Inclusion

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the use of your Data

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Overview

Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our Data Science team. This person will drive data science initiatives, provide technical guidance when needed, and leverage data to solve complex business challenges. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of data science methodologies, strong statistical expertise, and proven experience delivering impactful data solutions in a dynamic environment. This is a 1-year contract with the potential for extension.

Responsibilities

  • Use data analysis, visualization, and modeling tools (e.g., Looker, Jupyter Notebooks, Python, Pandas) to drive data-driven business strategies, with a focus on cost prediction for a two-sided marketplace.
  • Design and execute data science projects, including hypothesis development, statistical analysis, and experimentation (e.g., A/B testing) to answer key business questions and validate assumptions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into data science solutions and ensure alignment with Xometry’s objectives.
  • Analyze existing algorithms for accuracy and performance, provide recommendations for optimization, and update production code as necessary.
  • Query and extract data from databases (e.g., Snowflake, MongoDB) to support analysis and model development.
  • Implement robust data science methodologies, emphasizing best practices in code reproducibility, version control, and model deployment.
  • Continuously iterate and improve solutions within a fast-paced, agile environment, addressing challenges with innovative, data-driven approaches.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, teamwork, and continuous learning, encouraging knowledge sharing and skill development within the team.

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree is required; an advanced degree (M.S. or PhD) in applied math, computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field is highly preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in data science
  • Strong expertise in SQL and Python (numpy, scipy, pandas, and scikit-learn preferred) and experience with API integrations using Python.
  • Proficient in applied statistics, including knowledge of probability distributions, confidence intervals, statistical tests (e.g., t-tests, ANOVA, Chi-Square), and power analysis.
  • Experience with pricing algorithms and technology-driven product development.
  • Knowledge of scientific software principles, including version control, code reproducibility, and deployment practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and manage shifting priorities effectively.
  • Must be able to work core hours aligned with US Eastern Time (GMT-5).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with global teams and articulate complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

For US based roles: Xometry participates in E-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

title: YouTube Manager
description:
A Impact Media is on a mission to empower real estate professionals to own their market through media.

At A Impact Media, we hire for impact. If you’re exceptional at what you do and align with our core values—Beyond Excellence, Extreme Ownership, Proactive Curiosity, and Mission Focused—we want to know you.

Role

We are hiring a YouTube Manager for A Impact Media. The YouTube Manager is a strategic and creative leader who translates our clients’ business priorities into long‑form video content, and builds the top real estate channels across the country.

You’re not just managing YouTube channels. You’re leading strategy, storytelling, and systems behind uploads that scale our clients’ local authority to hundreds of thousands of impressions a year on YouTube. You are a multifaceted creative fluent in ideation, production planning, copywriting, post‑production oversight, and YouTube analytics. You’ll work to craft standout content that changes how top agents and teams approach media and market dominance. You will lead production, posting, and packaging direction, distill insights into engaging content, and ensure continuous improvement through analysis and feedback loops. You’ll maintain strategic alignment with key business initiatives and collaborate with YouTube Strategists, Client Success Managers, the creative team, and client teams to shape channel strategy, content production, and distribution.

If the idea of leading and growing YouTube’s top real estate channels excites you, let’s talk.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership and YouTube Infrastructure
  • Manage editors, thumbnail designers, and pre‑production team across multiple client accounts
  • Support relevant YouTube scorecard metrics (CTR, retention, view velocity, follower growth) and present insights to leadership and clients
  • Support scalable, documented systems for scripting, packaging, and production handoffs
  • Grow and develop direct reports and members of the YouTube Team
  • Explore and test AI tools to accelerate pre‑ and post‑production workflows; prototype AI‑driven content testing, retention analysis, and scripting support
  • Coordinate with marketing, shorts teams, and external stakeholders for distribution and promotion
  • YouTube Strategy and Channel Architecture
  • Support channel growth strategy with input from clients
  • Balance evergreen local content with timely reactions to market trends and experimental formats
  • Ensure every video educates and reinforces the authors’ authority, credibility, and mission while maintaining each brand’s distinct tone
  • Support the visual identity of packaging and run A/B tests on back catalogue
  • Keep scorecard metrics up to date and share weekly insights with team and clients
  • Pre‑Production
  • Support ideation and research sessions
  • Provide feedback on packaging briefs and video outlines
  • Maintain a four‑to‑six‑week buffer of fully approved topics (outlines, rough thumbnail concepts, title options)
  • Post‑Production
  • Own post‑production timelines and upload calendar
  • Conduct regular retention reviews to improve engagement
  • Collaborate with Senior Editor for retention notes and final approvals
  • Create brand guidelines, SOPs, and artifacts to streamline post‑production
  • Results
  • Support 45‑60+ videos monthly within your team, managing around 5–10 clients
  • 90%+ on‑time delivery rate
  • Client channels achieving 100–1000 subscriber growth monthly
  • Support client revenue goals (generating leads monthly and $7.5–$10M+ in sales per client per year)
  • 50–75% of videos outperform baselines on impressions and subscriber growth
  • Lift in subscriber‑to‑view ratios; higher average views and faster velocity
  • Regular documentation of content experiments and A/B tests
  • Improved use of AI and other tools to increase team leverage
  • Positive client sentiment on brand and growth

Requirements

  • Understanding of the YouTube landscape—concepts, thumbnails, titles, and retention editing
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical fundamentals and ability to work with data
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in YouTube channel development; bonus points for a large educational channel
  • Proficiency with editing notes tools (e.g., Frame.io)
  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Notion)
  • Proficiency with G Suite
  • Knowledge of editing and Photoshop is a plus but not required

Communication Expectations

  • We use Slack as the primary communications tool
  • We value over‑communication and speed in responses
  • Weekly Creative Team Meetings
  • Weekly meetings with Media Manager/Team Leader
  • Weekly meetings with the creative team

Location : Remote (work from home)

Hours : Mon – Fri 9am–6pm EST with flexibility to work weekends when needed

Compensation : $16,800 – $28,800 USD annually with progression from part‑time to full‑time. Highly experienced YouTube strategists can earn $24,000–$36,000 USD per year.

Benefits

  • 30–60 day paid trial period
  • Flexible work arrangements (part‑time to full‑time path)
  • Remote work flexibility
  • Performance‑based advancement opportunities

Knwn Local Core Values

Our core values are the heart of this company. The right person will appreciate and embody them:

Beyond Excellence

We raise the bar and pursue mastery; excellence is a moving target.

Extreme Ownership

Own the outcome and take responsibility for results. Measure yourself by client success.

Proactive Curiosity

Curious minds build better things. Question everything and see challenges as opportunities.

Mission Focused

Align personal purpose with professional pursuit and help others succeed.

To apply

If you’re interested, please submit the following:

  1. A resume in PDF format named as: (Lastname.Firstname.YouTube-Manager.pdf)
  2. Links to YouTube channels you’ve managed and their growth metrics
  3. Link to your completed personality quiz: (link removed)

description:
Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians!

At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses — by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market.

Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike.

We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact — who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible.

If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.

Responsibilities

As a Tech Lead, you will play a strategic role, serving as a technical reference and team leader. This position requires a balance between technical expertise, people leadership, and project management.

  • Define team objectives and project goals, ensuring alignment with the company's broader strategies and objectives.
  • Facilitate communication within the squad and across technical and non-technical teams, ensuring alignment and timely delivery of high-quality outcomes.
  • Actively participating in the recruitment, training, and development of team members, fostering a productive and growth-oriented environment.
  • Collaborating with other technical leaders, aligning technology strategies and contributing to the evolution of the company's technical direction.
  • Ensuring the technical quality of deliverables, providing guidance and support in solving complex problems.
  • Promote the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices within your squad and chapter, leveraging tools for code generation, automated refactoring, test case creation, and technical documentation. Identify opportunities where AI can enhance developer productivity, code quality, and team velocity.
  • Guide conversations to remove blockers and encourage collaboration in your team.
  • Collaborate with the Product Owner to ensure technical initiatives, such as refactoring, performance tuning, and tech debt—are properly scoped and prioritized within the product backlog.
  • Ensure implementation of quality and observability standards, including automated testing, monitoring, alerting, and logging across the development lifecycle.
  • Lead retrospectives and continuous improvement efforts, driving team evolution through feedback and actionable insights.
  • Support team staffing decisions by matching people to tasks based on skills, priorities, and development opportunities.
  • Support the definition and follow-up of individual development goals aligned with team objectives and business priorities.
  • Academic background oriented toward computer science, engineering, or software development disciplines.
  • Proven track record of leading teams and working in product-driven companies.
  • Hands-on experience in backend (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL, AWS) and optionally frontend development, with a track record of delivering scalable systems.
  • Experience in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with asynchronous programming.
  • Experience working with domains of medium to high complexity.
  • A solid understanding of how web and mobile applications work including security, session management, and best development practices.
  • Knowledge of relational database systems and Object Oriented Programming.
  • Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and experience designing or maintaining microservices-based systems.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn rapidly and master diverse web and mobile technologies and techniques.
  • Practical experience applying AI frameworks in development projects.
  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and experience with agile methodologies.
  • Advanced Problem-Solving and Decision-Making Skills.
  • Ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Competence in defining clear objectives and ensuring the team meets project milestones.
  • Experience guiding and leading teams to successful project deliveries within deadlines and budgets.
  • Ability to evaluate and prioritize technical work based on business value, system health, and long-term platform goals.
  • Experience conducting code reviews, driving knowledge sharing, and promoting collaborative development practices.
  • Experience building and developing high-performing engineering teams.
  • Active contribution to aligning technological strategies with broader organizational objectives.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, facilitating alignment and decision-making.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with Product Managers, Product Owners, Squad Leaders, Designers, and other teams, tribes or squads in defining priorities and delivering value.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, guiding career development, and fostering a growth-oriented, high-performance team environment.
  • Capacity to make thoughtful, context-aware decisions that balance technical debt, delivery speed, and business impact.
  • Ability to recognize team dynamics, support team members through challenges, and cultivate psychological safety.
  • Proactive in owning outcomes, addressing blockers, and ensuring that the squad delivers on commitments.
  • Comfortable working in changing environments, reprioritizing as needed, and adjusting to new business or technical demands.
  • Skilled in managing disagreements constructively and promoting consensus through dialogue.
  • Capable of influencing product and technical decisions at squad level and beyond, aligning technical initiatives with broader company goals.
  • Oriented toward retrospectives, feedback loops, and implementing process and culture improvements.
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability, with a bias for action and results-oriented problem solving.
  • Comfort operating at both strategic and hands-on levels, flexing between system design and stakeholder engagement as needed.
  • Ability to make decisions based on accurate information, technical indicators, and impact metrics, using data to prioritize initiatives, guide trade-offs, and measure success.


Industry-Specific Knowledge

As a Tech Leader, you bring practical familiarity with one or more core financial domains, such as lending, payments, credit cards, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, and understand the operational workflows, regulatory considerations, and business impact that shape these areas.

You leverage this knowledge not only to guide the technical implementation of backend solutions, such as payment orchestration, fraud-detection services, or onboarding flows, but also to collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and business stakeholders in defining priorities and making trade-offs that balance technical feasibility with strategic objectives.

Your role involves translating domain-specific requirements into actionable tasks, mentoring engineers to understand the business context behind their work, and ensuring the team delivers solutions that are robust, compliant, and aligned with customer needs. You help the squad connect technical work with revenue, performance, and user experience outcomes, creating an environment where engineers contribute with full awareness of business impact.

Process Stages

HR Interview
Our first contact will be a casual conversation to learn about you, your career journey, and align expectations. We’ll conduct a brief technical assessment and answer your questions about the role, our culture, and what makes us unique. We want you to get to know us better too! ????

We’ll dive into your decisions, strategies, and how you design scalable and robust solutions. Beyond evaluation, we want to exchange ideas and explore how your solutions can impact RecargaPay!

Conversation with Leadership
Here, you’ll meet the squad leader to understand the position’s challenges, discuss the team’s daily activities, and evaluate alignment between our goals, culture, and your career aspirations. This will be an open space to align expectations and ensure RecargaPay is a place where you can grow and make a difference. ????
Offer
If we’ve made it this far together, we’d be thrilled to invite you to join our team! You’ll receive a detailed proposal with all the information about the role, benefits, and the impact you’ll have with us. We can’t wait to welcome you!

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. title: Homebuying Specialist
description:
Overview

Are you competitive, persuasive, and ready to thrive in a remote sales role that rewards hustle and drive? Neighbors Bank, a leading innovator in the mortgage industry, is looking for ambitious sales professionals who know how to make connections, earn trust quickly, and drive conversations forward.

We\'re not looking for mortgage experts. We\'re looking for self-starters with a proven track record in sales — people who can sell over the phone, adapt quickly, and bring energy to every conversation. If you\'ve excelled in a high-volume sales role or competitive environment, you might be exactly who we need.

Our thriving remote culture isn\'t just a perk — it\'s a reflection of how we see the future of work. We want to empower incredible people to do a great job wherever they are, while enabling flexibility .

As a Homebuying Specialist, you\'ll be the voice that turns interest into action. You\'ll be the first point of contact for clients actively pursuing homeownership, allowing you to focus on what you do best — connecting with people and closing deals — without ever making a single cold call. You\'ll play a vital role in fulfilling our vision of making the dream of homeownership more affordable, accessible, and achievable.

What Makes This Role Exciting?

  • Remote-First with Flexibility: Flourish in a fully remote role with the freedom to structure your day, focus on performance, and rely on tools that support long-term success.
  • Big Rewards for Top Performers: Competitive, uncapped commissions and bonuses await those who excel. Top performers are earning over $50 per hour.
  • Be Part of Something Bigger: Join a fast-growing team with an award-winning culture that\'s been recognized as a Top Workplace in the Financial Services industry while making homeownership achievable for thousands of underserved families.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Including health and dental coverage, a wellness program, 401(k) matching, PTO, paid holidays, and more.
  • Problem Solvers Wanted: This role is ideal for individuals who tackle challenges and find innovative solutions.

Your Journey at Neighbors Bank

Most Homebuying Specialists earn $65,000-$80,000 annually, with top performers exceeding that range. We provide a comprehensive program to support you in reaching your income goals in remote sales and mortgage origination.

From day one, you\'ll earn a base pay of $20 per hour, plus uncapped performance-based bonuses . While this is a full-time role, your earnings potential is based on your production — not your schedule.

You\'ll also benefit from:

  • A structured onboarding program to help you master the loan origination process.
  • Real-time coaching and support from experienced team leads.
  • The flexibility to build a schedule that works for you.

This is a full-time position where you can expect to work up to 40 hours each week, but we are seeking individuals who can work at least 64 hours each month during the evenings and weekends (or roughly 16 hours per week after 5pm or any time Saturday and Sunday). You will have a high degree of flexibility with when you choose to work each week. Top performers maximize their earnings by leaning into evenings, weekends, and other high-conversion windows.

Our People and Culture

Our People and Culture are our greatest strengths. We\'re seeking individuals who:

  • Are passionate about their job and have fun doing it.
  • Will deliver results with integrity.
  • Enjoy finding ways to enhance the lives of others every day.

Your Role as a Homebuying Specialist

Homebuying Specialists are the first voice our customers hear, and a critical part of turning curiosity into confidence. Our clients seek support from Neighbors Bank, so there is no cold calling required. Your role is to connect quickly, ask the right questions, and guide potential borrowers through the first steps of the home loan process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build rapport and collect borrower financial and credit information.
  • Educate borrowers on the loan process and identify financing options.
  • Analyze credit, income, and assets to prequalify or deny applications.
  • Provide clear communication with borrowers while guiding them through initial documentation and next steps.
  • Secure documentation and ensure all stages of the loan process are completed efficiently.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Are You the One?

No mortgage experience? No problem — but sales talent, grit, and hustle are a must. We\'re looking for high-performing individuals with a proven ability to connect with people, work independently, and close the deal. Whether you come from a call center, cold-calling environment, or another competitive sales background, success in this role comes down to mindset and motivation.

This role rewards self-starters who can adapt quickly, think on their feet, and bring energy to every conversation. If that sounds like you, read on.

Here\'s what makes a great fit

  • Thrive working remotely and staying self-motivated.
  • Have succeeded in fast-paced or performance-based roles.
  • Bring a strong competitive drive and hunger to earn.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with customers.
  • Stay focused under pressure and in high-volume settings.
  • College degrees are not required, but the ability to learn quickly is essential.

This isn\'t the role for you if

  • You need frequent oversight to stay on track.
  • You prefer routine tasks over rapid change.
  • You're not comfortable and confident talking to customers on the phone.

Where We\'re Hiring

We\'re actively hiring in the following states: AL, AZ, AR, FL, ID, IA, KS, MS, MO, MT, OK, TX, UT, and VA.

Why Neighbors Bank?

Neighbors Bank is more than just a workplace — it\'s a community. Our mission is to Enhance Lives , and we\'re passionate about doing that through innovative solutions and a culture of collaboration and excellence. If you\'re ready to join a team where your contributions truly matter, we\'d love to hear from you!

The People and the Culture are Neighbors Bank\'s greatest strengths. We seek individuals who are passionate about their job, deliver results with integrity, and enjoy enhancing the lives of others every day.

Neighbors Bank is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected classifications.

  • Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvedores, arquitetos, segurança e stakeholders de negócio, para assegurar que as soluções atendam às necessidades técnicas e estratégicas da organização.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência em áreas como desenvolvimento de software, arquitetura de soluções ou infraestrutura em nuvem.
  • Experiência específica com AWS e projetos de migração/modernização.
  • Vivência anterior em projetos de grande escala ou ambientes corporativos complexos.
  • Experiência em consultoria, pré-venda técnica ou relacionamento com clientes é um diferencial importante.

  • Nível avançado de inglês
  • Espanhol avançado
  • Conhecimentos em arquiteturas orientadas a dados, modelagem de dados, pipelines de ingestão e processamento (ETL/ELT) e ferramentas de Data Lake/Data Warehouse.
  • Familiaridade com serviços da AWS voltados a dados e IA, como Glue, Athena, Redshift, SageMaker, Bedrock, Comprehend, Kendra ou equivalentes.
  • Interesse ou experiência prática em projetos envolvendo Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning, engenharia de dados ou analytics preditivo.

Habilidades Comportamentais

  • Prontidão: Rapidez e Eficiência.

title: Study Coordinator
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Study Coordinator role at Inside Higher Ed .

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

To coordinate study participants in the Clinical Trials Unit. Execute tasks as required by the study protocols.

Supervisory Authority

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

Interacts with physicians, immediate staff members, research participants, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Maintain familiarity with the protocol. Evaluate study candidates for eligibility into the study.
  • Meet with the patient’s caretaker to review the details of study enrollment.
  • Assure that informed consent has been obtained from the patient’s legal guardian and consent from the patient when applicable prior to the initiation of research-related activities.
  • Schedule tests and appointments for patients within appropriate timeframes.
  • Send the prescriptions for study medication to the research pharmacist, including the height, weight or body surface area.
  • Identify abnormal laboratory results and obtain repeat evaluations as required by the protocol.
  • Complete case report forms accurately and thoroughly and enter data electronically.
  • Maintain source documentation in shadow files for each study participant.
  • Respond to date inquiries in a timely manner.
  • Complete Serious Adverse Event Reports within the proper timeframes.
  • Report to the Project Director and the Principal Investigator regarding assignments and duties.
  • Perform other duties as instructed by the Principal Investigator and Project Director.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of clinical trials protocols.
  • Knowledge of management regulations of Howard University.
  • Knowledge of the educational and research goals of grant.
  • Knowledge of federal and Howard University grant policies, administration and regulation.
  • Excellent skill in the operation of desktop computer and software applications to include e-mail and calendar functionality, word processing, spreadsheet applications and presentation software.
  • Competence in both oral and written English to communicate in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students and customers.

Minimum Requirements

Minimum of a Bachelor of Science degree. Course study concentration in a health-related field is desirable.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$50,000-$60,000

Employment type

  • Full-time

  • Research, Analyst, and Information Technology

  • Online Audio and Video Media

title: Junior YouTube Strategist
description:
When you apply, please make sure the subject line is: "I actually read the instructions"

This position is completely remote and may start part-time or full-time depending on the right fit, with a path to full-time for the right candidate.

Job Overview We are seeking a detail-oriented YouTube Production Manager to join our fast-growing marketing agency that helps top-ranked real estate teams ($10M to $1B/YR+ in annual volume) build their personal media brands. Your role is to oversee our video production ecosystem, ensuring flawless execution of 45-80 high-quality videos monthly (with a team of 3-5 people) while maintaining exceptional client satisfaction and channel growth.

Are you obsessed with YouTube (or Social Media)success? Someone who lives and breathes video optimization? Do you have a talent for managing multiple brand voices and coordinating creative teams? Are you equally comfortable diving into analytics and providing strategic direction? If so, we might be the perfect match.

Core Responsibilities

  • Lead entire video production workflow from raw footage to final publishing
  • Coordinate resources across editing, thumbnail, and publishing teams
  • Manage channel optimization and publishing schedules for multiple real estate clients
  • Track and optimize team capacity and production efficiency
  • Implement and refine production SOPs and best practices
  • Monitor YouTube analytics and adjust strategies for maximum channel growth
  • Ensure consistent 48-72 hour turnaround times while maintaining quality standards
  • Drive client success metrics including subscriber growth and lead generation

Requirements

  • 2+ years experience in video production management, preferably in YouTube content
  • Strong understanding of YouTube best practices and optimization strategies
  • Experience managing creative teams and coordinating multiple projects
  • Proficiency with project management tools (Asana preferred)
  • Excellence in organization and timeline management
  • Strong analytical skills for performance tracking and optimization
  • Outstanding communication abilities

Expected Results

  • 45-60+ videos consistently delivered monthly
  • Client channels achieving subscriber growth monthly
  • Support of client revenue goals ($7.5-10M+ in sales per client)
  • Seamless team coordination and workflow optimization

Who we are

A Impact Media is a specialized creative agency helping real estate professionals build their own media brands instead of buying leads. We transform top-producing agents and teams (doing $10M to $1B+/YR in annual volume) into local market authorities through done-for-you YouTube content, email marketing, and brand development.

Our dedicated team of 30+ creative professionals has generated over 10M+ YouTube views and helped our clients achieve more than $250M in sales. We're not just a service provider we're a growth partner obsessed with turning real estate professionals into media companies that naturally attract the right clients and team members.

With a track record of producing over 1,200 videos, 3,600+ thumbnails, and hundreds of newsletters for industry leaders, we combine creative excellence with proven systems to deliver consistent results. Our core values of proactive curiosity, transparent communication, extreme accountability, and beyond excellence drive everything we do.

Make sure you're comfortable with:

  • Remote working. This is completely remote (work from home) position.
  • Open opportunities to work as much or as little as you want
  • All job offers start with a 30 to 60-day paid trial to make sure that we're the right fit for each other.
  • Pay ranges depending on skill & experience, as well as progressing over time through onboarding to full from $1400 to $2400 USD per month.

To apply: If you're interested, please submit the following:

  • A link to your resume in PDF format with the following naming convention: (Lastname.Firstname.Junior-YouTube-Strategist.pdf)
  • Links to YouTube channels you've managed and their growth metrics
  • Your answer to this question: What's the most innovative YouTube strategy you've implemented and what were the results?
  • Your answer to this question: What does this quote mean to you personally? "Work is love made visible" - Khalil Gibran

I will be looking for people who can format their submission in a way that makes it easy for us to review. Remember, in production management you want to help make processes as efficient as possible! I'm happy to answer any questions you may include in your application.

Thank you for your consideration and best of luck on your job search!

description:
Visão geral

Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brasil

Somos a Stone, uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no cliente. Nascemos para transformar a indústria de pagamentos, servindo o empreendedor brasileiro e gerando resultados. Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamento do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas em todo o país, valorizando trabalho em equipe, flexibilidade, desenvolvimento contínuo e pensamento disruptivo na busca da nossa razão de existir.

Guiados pelos pilares: Own It, Live the Ride, No Bullshit, Team Play e The Reason, buscamos autonomia, aprendizado com os erros, simplicidade, colaboração, e foco no impacto para o cliente.

Como é ser um(a) Líder de Vendas - Inside Sales (Inbound/Outbound)

Sua missão será liderar um time de vendas consultivas, acompanhar indicadores, traçar planos de ação para alcançar resultados, desenvolver a equipe, fornecer feedbacks constantes, construir planos de desenvolvimento individual e de carreira e reforçar a cultura de foco no(a) cliente.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar entregas, indicadores, resultados operacionais e rotinas do time sob sua liderança;
  • Analisar indicadores e construir planos de ação;
  • Desenvolver o time através da construção de PDIs e planos de ação estruturados;
  • Compreender a fundo o mercado;
  • Contribuir com novos insights quanto a fluxos, processos e resultados;
  • Realizar projetos focados na melhoria de processos;
  • Participar do processo de contratação de novos agentes;
  • Conduzir reuniões de rotina com o time;
  • Garantir a qualidade do processo de venda do time.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia como liderança por no mínimo 6 meses e vontade genuína de liderar pessoas;
  • Graduação superior (sem exigência de curso específico);
  • Conhecimento em Excel para gerar relatórios e análises de indicadores;
  • Habilidade de comunicação e escuta ativa;
  • Habilidade para articulação de problemas com diferentes públicos;
  • Proatividade para aprender e melhorar continuamente.

Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Segunda a sexta e escala esporádica aos finais de semana.

Modelo e Local de trabalho:

  • Híbrido | Dias presenciais - Cinelândia (Rio de Janeiro)

Benefícios: plano de saúde e odontológico; vale-refeição/vale alimentação; auxílio creche; vale-transporte (presenciais); salário fixo; remuneração variável e PLR (quando houver)

Benefícios educacionais: plataforma interna com livros, podcasts, treinamentos e videoaulas (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo).

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

Inscrição: cadastre-se e realize os testes essenciais. O time analisará seu perfil e entrará em contato.

Apresentação Pessoal: preencha o questionário de vida para apresentar trajetória, hobbies, motivações e sonhos.

Entrevistas com o time de People: conhecer cultura, estrutura e o desafio proposto.

Entrevista com a Liderança: avaliação de hard skills e apresentação de possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura: conversa com guardião da cultura para alinhamento de crenças e visão de futuro.

Feedback: compartilharemos o resultado e os próximos passos independente do desfecho.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

A Stone Co. valoriza as melhores pessoas para melhorar a vida de empreendedores no Brasil. Caso queira saber mais:

  • Conhecer nosso propósito no YouTube
  • Acessar artigos, cursos e vídeos no nosso Blog
  • Acompanhar novidades no Twitter

title: YouTube Editor
description:
YouTube Editor

When you apply, please make sure the subject line is: I actually read the instructions

If you can't edit like this, this job is not for you. You must at least be able to edit at this level:

This is another example. If you can edit like this, you are very likely to get higher pay:

A Impact Media is on a mission to make great real estate agents known well.

At A Impact Media, we don\'t just create videoswe transform real estate businesses. If you\'re exceptional at what you do and align with our core values: proactive curiosity, transparent communication, extreme accountability, and beyond excellence, we want to know you.

We\'re hiring a YouTube Editor to join our specialized creative team serving 55+ real estate clients on a full-time, remote basis.

Role:

As a YouTube Editor focused on real estate content, you will play a critical role in transforming raw footage into high-impact content. These retention-driven videos generate millions in sales for our clients. You will work directly under our YouTube Manager and alongside a high-performing media team, shaping stories that drive growth and strengthen personal brands. This role combines creative ownership with collaborative problem-solving, turning real estate expertise into world-class content together.

Responsibilities:

As a YouTube Editor focused on real estate content, your role is to transform direct-to-camera, area-touring videos, and agent expertise into high-impact, retention-driven videos that generate leads and build authority. You\'ll solve the problem of turning valuable real estate insights into world-class content that holds attention and drives growth.

  • Edit and deliver multiple high-quality YouTube videos every week, maintaining consistent 72-hour turnaround times

  • Communicate daily, promptly, and often

  • Collaborate with team members to create engaging promotional content from long-form edits

  • Report progress daily and align priorities to maintain seamless workflows

  • Conduct competitor analysis and trend research to stay ahead of industry standards

  • Keep project files and asset management well-organized and up-to-date

  • Share editing resources (e.g., motion graphics templates, intros) with other team members

  • Identify potential challenges early and communicate solutions effectively

  • Provide feedback on raw footage to the production team for improved outcomes

  • Contribute to data collection, video retention graphs, and conduct post-mortem reviews for continuous improvement

  • Offer constructive revision feedback to other team members on their edits

  • Monitor client channels for performance metrics and optimization opportunities

Requirements:

We\'re looking for someone who combines technical mastery with a growth mindset and thrives in a fast-paced, high-standard team environment. You should love solving creative problems and care deeply about delivering content that truly impacts viewers.

  • Minimum 2-3 years of professional editing experience

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects; familiarity with other tools (DaVinci Resolve) is a plus

  • Solid foundation in motion graphics, or a willingness to quickly learn and integrate on-brand graphics

  • A portfolio showcasing your best work (required)

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with a proactive and solutions-focused mindset

  • Ability to balance speed and quality and align with brand standards and overall creative direction

  • Eagerness to experiment with new tools, workflows, and approaches to stay ahead

  • Strong alignment with A Impact Media\'s core values and team culture

You\'ll be expected to contribute not just as an editor but also as a creative partner, helping to build a culture of excellence across the media team.

Results:

Your work will directly support our clients\' channel growth and elevate content quality, ensuring they stay ahead of industry standards and audience expectations.

  • Deliver high-quality edits on time, driving strong retention and watch time metrics

  • Support a consistent publishing cadence by maintaining a healthy backlog of ready-to-go content

  • Contribute to growing our clients\' reach and impact, targeting strong view velocity and engagement metrics

  • Maintain creative standards across the team by contributing to internal systems, workflows, and overall visual direction in alignment with client brands

  • Enable real estate professionals to deliver consistent, high-value market insights to their audiences content that would not exist without your contribution

Location:

Fully remote position - work from anywhere with reliable WiFi

Compensation:

$1,400 - $2,200 per month based on volume output, skill & experience 30-60 day paid trial period to ensure mutual fit

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work environment

  • Work with 55+ established real estate clients generating $10M+ income annually

  • Part of a dedicated team of 55+ creative professionals

  • Structured production system with clear processes and support

  • Growth opportunities into creative management/leadership roles

  • Flexible workload options

A Impact Media Core Values

Our core values determine who succeeds here. The right person will live these values, not just read them.

Beyond Excellence

We raise the bar, then we raise it again. Good enough is not good enough. We find joy in the pursuit of mastery and believe excellence is a moving target.

Extreme Ownership

Own the outcome. Take full responsibility for results. Say "I will" instead of "they should." Measure yourself by your clients\' success.

Proactive Curiosity

Curious minds build better things. Question everything. Connect ideas others miss. Ask "What if?" and "Why not?" See challenges as opportunities to learn.

Mission Focused

Small things build big things. Align personal purpose with professional pursuit. Find fulfillment in the work itself. Believe that helping others succeed is the highest calling.

To apply:

If you\'re interested, please submit the following:

  • A link to your resume in PDF format with the following naming convention: (Lastname.Firstname.YouTube-Editor.pdf)
  • Details of your video editing experience
  • Send a link to your completed personality quiz (Google CVI if link doesn\'t work):
  • Your answer to this question: What does this quote mean to you personally? "Work is love made visible" - Khalil Gibran

Submissions should go to:

I will be looking for people who can format their submission in a way that makes it easy for us to review. Remember, in client management you want to help make it as easy on the client as possible! Im happy to answer any questions you may include in your application.

Thank you for your consideration and best of luck on your job search!

title: YouTube Manager
description:
Overview

A Impact Media is on a mission to empower real estate professionals to own their market through media. We hire for impact and value core principles: beyond excellence, extreme ownership, proactive curiosity, and mission focus. If you’re exceptional at what you do and align with these values, we want to hear from you.

Role: We are hiring a YouTube Manager for A Impact Media. The YouTube Manager is a strategic and creative leader who connects our clients\' business priorities with long-form video strategy. You\'re building top real estate channels across the country, making clients locally famous, and setting a high bar for content. You\'ll own the strategy, the story, and the systems behind uploads that scale our clients\' local authority to hundreds of thousands of impressions a year on YouTube. This role blends creativity with analytics across ideation, production planning, post-production oversight, and YouTube performance.

Your curiosity for real estate fundamentals matches your passion for dominating YouTube\'s local market. You\'re excited to craft standout content that changes how top agents and teams approach media and market leadership. You\'ll lead production, posting, and packaging directions, distill insights into engaging content, and drive continuous improvement through analysis and feedback while maintaining alignment with business initiatives. You\'ll collaborate with our YouTube Strategists/Client Success Manager, creative team, and client teams to shape channel strategy, content production, and distribution.

Location: Remote (work from home). Hours: Mon – Fri 9am – 6pm EST with flexibility to work weekends when needed. Compensation and benefits reflect experience and progression from part-time to full-time roles.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership and YouTube Infrastructure

  • Manage editors, thumbnail designers, and pre-production team across multiple client accounts
  • Support relevant YouTube scorecard metrics (CTR, retention, view velocity, follower growth) and present insights to leadership and clients
  • Support scalable, documented systems for scripting, packaging, and production handoffs
  • Grow and develop direct reports and members of the YouTube Team
  • Explore and test AI tools to accelerate pre- and post-production workflows; identify opportunities to prototype AI-driven content testing, retention analysis, and scripting support
  • Coordinate with marketing, Shorts teams, and external stakeholders for distribution and promotion

YouTube Strategy and Channel Architecture

  • Support YouTube channel growth strategy with input from clients
  • Balance evergreen local content with timely reactions to market trends and other experimental formats
  • Ensure every video educates while reinforcing the authority, credibility, and mission of our clients; maintain each brand\'s distinct tone and consistency
  • Support the visual identity of packaging and run consistent A/B testing for packaging on back catalogue
  • Keep relevant YouTube scorecard metrics and present weekly insights to team and clients

Pre-Production

  • Support ideation and outlier research sessions
  • Provide feedback and insight on packaging briefs and video outlines
  • Maintain a four-to-six-week buffer of fully approved topics (outlines, rough thumbnail concepts and title options)

Post-Production

  • Ownership and management of post-production timelines and upload calendar
  • Conduct regular retention reviews to improve audience engagement
  • Work with Senior Editor to provide retention notes and final approval for uploads
  • Create brand guidelines, SOPs, and artifacts to streamline post-production

Results

  • Support 45-60+ videos monthly within your team; you\'ll primarily manage around 5-10 clients
  • 90%+ on-time delivery rate
  • Client channels achieving subscriber growth monthly
  • Support client revenue goals (generating leads monthly and 7.5–10M+ in annual sales per client)
  • 50–75% of videos outperform channel baselines in impressions and subscriber growth
  • Lift in subscriber-to-view ratios; higher average views per video and faster velocity in 24/48 hours
  • Document content experiments and A/B tests; increase AI/tool usage to boost team leverage
  • Improved client sentiment on brand and growth through performance discussions

Requirements

  • Understanding of the YouTube landscape — concepts, thumbnails, titles, and retention editing
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical fundamentals and ability to work with data
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in YouTube channel development (bonus for large educational channels)
  • Proficiency with editing notes tools (e.g., frame.io)
  • Proficiency with Notion and GSuite
  • Knowledge of editing and Photoshop is a plus but not required

Communication Expectations

  • Slack is the go-to for communications
  • Value over-communication and speed in responses
  • Weekly Creative Team Meetings, Weekly meetings with Media Manager/Team Leader, and Weekly meetings with the creative team

Compensation

Salary range is $16,800 – $28,800 USD annually, with progression from part-time to full-time. Highly experienced YouTube strategists can earn $24,000 – $36,000 USD a year.

Benefits

  • 30–60 day paid trial period
  • Flexible work arrangements (part-time to full-time path)
  • Remote work flexibility
  • Performance-based advancement opportunities

How to Apply

To apply, please submit: a PDF resume named according to your name, links to YouTube channels and growth metrics, a completed personality quiz URL, and responses to the following questions:

  1. What\'s the most innovative YouTube strategy you\'ve implemented and what were the results?
  2. What does the quote "Work is love made visible" by Khalil Gibran mean to you personally?
  3. Link to your submission materials: (email)

Submissions should go to the email address above. I\'m happy to answer any questions you may have about the application process. Thank you for your consideration.

title: Amazon Account Manager - Sao Paulo
description:
Overview

AMZ Advisers Amazon Account Manager Job Description

About AMZ Advisers: AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces. Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. This structure fosters knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning.

About the Role: We’re seeking a driven and self-motivated problem solver with exceptionally strong communication skills and the ability to build long-lasting client relationships. You will be provided a fast-paced, challenging, and creative environment with opportunities to sharpen your analytical, communication, and strategic development skills, and to learn more about online marketing to enhance your professional career.

The ideal candidate is an independent thinker and will be able to manage multiple Amazon Seller and Vendor Central accounts as well as a team of Junior Account Managers and Apprentices/Interns. As a Senior Account Manager, you will provide guidance, mentorship, and strategic oversight for other Account Managers in your pod by contributing to the development of training programs, while ensuring the success of your pod’s client portfolio. You will embrace the challenge of managing your own client portfolio, leading your team, and strategic planning.

What You’ll Do

  • General Responsibilities

  • Maintain a portfolio that will gradually grow to 10 clients and aim to hold a high retention rate.

  • Build long-lasting client relationships by clearly and concisely managing expectations.

  • Build and track KPIs for all accounts under personal client portfolio management.

  • Bi-weekly strategy calls with clients to communicate results and upcoming strategies.

  • Proactively brainstorm and implement strategies to grow client accounts on Amazon and manage client expectations.

  • Reporting and strategizing account progress and action items.

  • Plan and implement or delegate promotional plans and strategies.

  • Delegate the resolution of client account issues through troubleshooting and opening cases with Seller Support.

  • Work within software platforms such as Zonguru.

  • Work with other departments to accomplish overall, high level goals.

  • Attend Account Management meetings and training sessions on a weekly or bi-weekly basis.

  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise problems or blockers for timely resolution to keep tasks on track.

Team Structure & Development

  • Team Assignment: Assign team members to clients based on skills, expertise, and client portfolios.

  • Ensure a balanced mix of experience levels for each team member to facilitate knowledge sharing.

  • Training & Onboarding: Develop comprehensive training programs for Junior Account Managers, focusing on industry knowledge, account management best practices, and company processes. Mentor and guide junior team members in collaboration with Strategists.

  • Integrate Strategists: Conduct client account audits and develop tailored client strategies; collaborate with the team to implement effective strategies.

  • Pod Collaboration: Foster regular collaboration within pods through meetings, brainstorming, and strategy discussions; facilitate communication and document sharing.

  • Check-ins & Accountability: Conduct regular check-ins with teams to assess client progress, address issues, and identify new strategies; determine upsell opportunities and encourage proactive problem solving.

  • Client Communication & Feedback: Emphasize proactive and transparent client communication; encourage client feedback and ensure swift conflict resolution.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Retention Rate: Percentage of retained clients month over month.

  • Blocker/Conflict Resolution Time: Time to resolve client issues or blockers.

  • Client Communication: Quality and frequency of client interactions.

  • Strategy Effectiveness: Success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics.

  • Pod Follow Ups: Regular follow ups to assess client performance.

  • Team Member Development: Progress and development of junior team members.

Qualifications

  • BA in Marketing, Business Development, Management, or related fields.

  • 2+ years with client account management.

  • 2+ years digital marketing or eCommerce experience.

  • 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller and/or Vendor Central.

  • Ability to build and maintain client relations.

  • Active listening and the ability to understand client needs.

  • Proactive, go-getter mindset who functions well within a team setting but can work independently.

  • Strong ability to think outside the box and develop growth strategies.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask.

  • Willingness to learn new skills.

  • Technologies We Use:

    • G-Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

    • Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

    • ClickUp

    • LastPass

    • Slack

    • Zonguru

    • Zoom

  • Day off on your birthday

  • Summer Time (short Fridays in August)

title: Quality Control Analyst
description:
About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

Role Description

The Quality Control Team play a critical role in maintaining data quality across the business. Data is at the core of our operations, and it is essential that this data is of a high standard at all times. The QC Analyst will work as part of the Commercial Team to drive data accuracy across the region, as well as being a part of the Global QC Team, sharing best practices, improvement initiatives and maintaining consistency across all regions. Attention to detail is paramount and strong communication skills are essential as there will be significant collaboration with other departments, in particular with the Recruitment and Service Teams.

Principle Accountabilities:

  • Review Bullhorn records within the agreed timeframes and issue approval or query notes as appropriate. This may include Contract Placements, Change Requests, Perm/Direct Hire placements, GEM Placements, Client Records, Opportunity Records and Requirement Records.
  • Work with the relevant parties to ensure that any errors are corrected in a timely manner.
  • Produce reporting and analysis to provide key stakeholders with an accurate and up to date view of data accuracy across the region.
  • Hold regular QC review meetings with relevant departments to discuss any issues and identify key areas for improvement.
  • Collaborate with other QC Coordinators, both regionally and globally, to share best practices and drive process improvement, in particular to deal with interregional placements efficiently.
  • Take a proactive approach to data clean-up e.g., updating fields in Bullhorn when a staff member leaves
  • Support the QA/PIs with QC related process improvement projects
  • Special adhoc projects, as directed by the Commercial Operations Manager
  • Liaise closely with Payroll & Billing to ensure contract compliance relating to payroll and invoicing
  • Work closely with Sales Team to ensure quality and contract compliance
  • Ensure that Bullhorn and any relevant trackers are updated accordingly

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Excellent technical skills including all Microsoft Office products
  • Strong numerical skills
  • Ability to problem solve
  • Attention to detail
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to make decisions and prioritise objectives
  • Must be a self-starter and able to work without supervision
  • Able to handle demanding situations

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values:

  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

Visit our website and social media to find out more! -

description:
A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é ser uma pessoa Sênior Data Engineer:

Estamos buscando pessoas engenheiras de dados com background e expertise na área, criativas, com energia, comprometidas, que saiba trabalhar bem em equipe, com foco de resolver o problema do cliente com muita qualidade e que queiram encarar conosco o desafio de fazer parte do time de tecnologia responsável pelo Crédito da Stone.

Nosso produto está na rua a todo vapor e queremos escalar ainda mais nosso produto ampliando a sua capacidade, aproveitando todo seu potencial e melhorar ainda mais os pilares técnicos e de eficiência. Nosso produto tem interação com diversas fontes de dados importantes e cruciais para a vida do ciclo de crédito, sejam nossos dados internos cadastrais e transacionais, dados de provedores externos sobre endividamento, restritivo, rede de relacionamento, garantias e os diversos dados internos da companhia. Integrar, transformar e disponibilizar esses dados não é uma tarefa fácil e com todo volume que temos o desafio se torna ainda maior. Pra continuar no caminho certo, precisamos das melhores pessoas, que saibam contribuir bem em time e trabalhar sem ego, afinal, só como um time temos grandes resultados!

Importante lembrar que o nosso desafio requer pessoas com pensamentos de processar dados, construindo processos de qualidade e dispostas a construir sistemas altamente escaláveis e resilientes.

Junto ao time, você será responsável por:

  • Você irá compor um time de alta performance com o foco em: projetar, desenvolver, testar, implantar, manter e melhorar o processos de engenharia de dados com foco em solucionar problemas reais dos nossos clientes;
  • Auxiliar na construção de soluções com visão de longo prazo e muita qualidade;
  • Você será um defensor das boas práticas, nossos acordos e processos, revisões, testes e documentações dentro do seu time e influenciar esta cultura o máximo possível;
  • É esperado de você extrema facilidade de trabalho em equipe, muita franqueza e transparência para que no dia-a-dia possa ter ótimo relacionamento com o time e transmitir conhecimento;
  • Aqui todos possuem a mente aberta para trabalhar com qualquer tecnologia, muita vontade de aprender e entregar resultado, além de ser apaixonado por tecnologia e sistemas de alta performance;

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência em linguagem de desenvolvimento para ferramentas e rotinas de Data Engineering (Python, Java, Scala ou outras);
  • Processo de Data Quality / qualidade e testes para Engenharia de Dados;
  • Conhecimentos de processamento com Databricks / ferramentas de Big Data;
  • Experiência com operação de serviços na nuvem;

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Experiência em projetos voltados para a área financeira;
  • Experiência com aplicações críticas e de alta disponibilidade;

Tech Lead, Web Core Product & Chrome Extension - Recife, Brazil

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting. This includes frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

  • Work closely with your dedicated product team
  • Participate in product discussions to shape the product roadmap
  • Have the opportunity to work on new and exciting features that will impact millions of lives

  • Speed. You work quickly to generate ideas and know how to decide which things can ship now and what things need time
  • Focus. We’re a high-growth startup with a busy, remote team. You know how and when to engage or be heads down
  • Collaboration. You know how to inspire, play, and negotiate with opinionated designers, marketers, and PMs
  • Tech Stack: Vanilla JS, ReactJS, Redux, Firebase, Typescript

What We Offer

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the culture

description:
Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

A área de Relacionamento Automatizado posiciona-se como um pilar estratégico na jornada do cliente da Stone Co. Somos responsáveis pela governança e planejamento estratégico das nossas plataformas de conversação inteligente: o "Piloto", chatbot de atendimento direto ao cliente das marcas Ton e Stone, e o "Copiloto", ferramenta de suporte de alta performance para nossos encantadores.

Como é ser um (a) Data Analyst Pleno:

Você será responsável por análises, monitoramentos, criação e revisão de pipelines de dados e automatização de processos voltados à identificação de ineficiências e melhoria contínua.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar análises quantitativas (utilizando SQL e/ou Python) que sustentem a tomada de decisão, como deep dive de indicadores da operação ou projeções de demanda
  • Elaborar análises qualitativas que sustentem a tomada de decisão, como curadorias e entrevistas
  • Formular hipóteses, validar com dados quanti e/ou quali e comunicar os principais aprendizados para áreas interessadas
  • Desenvolver relatórios gerenciais com foco em resultados e performance de negócio
  • Construir visualizações de dados, utilizando predominantemente o Looker, para dar visibilidade aos números da operação
  • Implementar rotinas de monitoramento contínuo para garantir a confiabilidade dos dados e consistência nas análises
  • Desenvolver e manter consultas de dados que sirvam como fonte única da verdade
  • Mapear e documentar processos atuais com foco na identificação de ineficiências e pontos de melhoria
  • Auxiliar na revisão de processos, com ênfase na automatização de demandas utilizando Google Sheets e/ou Python

O que esperamos de você:

  • Capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal ;
  • Capacidade de negociação;
  • Proatividade e autonomia ;
  • SQL Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Storytelling de dados;

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Python (Tem conhecimento de bibliotecas como Pandas, Numpy e Matplot);
  • Noções de modelagem de dados (ETL, Dimensionamento de tabelas, e Criação de pipeline de dados);
  • Experiência prévia em áreas (técnicas ou operacionais) de atendimento/relacionamento com o cliente;

Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias: 09h às 18hs;
  • Segunda à sexta-feira;

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Apresentação de case: Prepare-se para um desafio! Você receberá um case prático para demonstrar suas habilidades.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiães da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente! Caso queira saber mais:

  • Temos vários artigos, cursos e vídeos para o seu desenvolvimento no nosso Blog .
  • E pra ficar por dentro de todas as novidades, é só nos seguir no Twitter .
